contract.span_indexing: Python Unicode code points; zero-based [start,end); SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 substring
contract.root: response.input.fen only; no annotator replacement FEN
contract.context: Explicit legal branch replay and expected side to move; ambiguous or invalid context is unassessed
contract.mapping: Human semantic correspondence is required separately; hashes do not establish it
contract.material: Counts of pawn/knight/bishop/rook/queen by one side; not piece values or advantage
contract.geometry: Occupancy-aware attack geometry includes pinned pieces; never legal recapture or tactical success
contract.variation: Explicit asserted line only; no engine attribution or whole-prose inference
contract.history: Standalone current FEN and explicit branch only; prior repetition is not inferred
contract.purpose: Evaluator only; never generator input, repair, training target or current heldout metric

research_basis.title: Hallucinations on the Board: Tool-Augmented Evaluation of LLM Chess Commentary
research_basis.reading_scope: Official abstract and framework outline; local deterministic/manual subset, not ACT-Eval reproduction.

response_pool.kind: Four already spent authored software demonstrations; not heldout or representative commentary benchmark.

selection: Manual inventory of explicit narrow candidate claims in these four raw responses; bind spans/predicates/branches, retain unsupported or ambiguous entries. Root/reviewer must approve semantic correspondence before actual audit; no cherry-picked whole-prose rate.
hard_reject: ambiguous JSON or malformed annotation envelope
reporting: Counts and fractions among manual annotations/assessed annotations only. Unsupported/ambiguous items retained. No whole-prose coverage, strength, pedagogy, forcedness, strategic value, or heldout quality claim.
generator_boundary: Evaluator outputs, replayed FENs, branch failures and repaired claims must never feed the generator, current training corpus, or heldout metrics.
